venue.name: Monk's Rathtrevor Beach Studio
venue.description: Monk's Rathtrevor Beach Studio is the second Parksville address of the artist who signs her work MONK, at #5 1065 Tanglewood Place next to Beach Acres Resort. The site calls it her primary studio and says the painting happens on the deck or the grass when the weather allows. The footer adds that on Sundays MONK can be visited on Rathtrevor Beach where she paints. The same business also runs MONK Art Gallery & Studio on Morison Avenue in central Parksville, which is listed separately, and the painting sessions she offers to families and community groups are recorded on that entry.
venue.hours_notes: Sunday: Monk can be visited on Rathtrevor Beach in Parksville where she paints.

programs.name: Visit MONK at the beach studio
programs.description: The site gives this address as MONK's primary studio and says the work happens on the deck or the grass when the weather allows. Under its opening times the site says that on Sundays MONK can be visited on Rathtrevor Beach where she paints. No price, length, age range or group size is published, and the site does not say whether a booked group is welcome here or at the Morison Avenue gallery.
programs.what_children_do: Children stand outside beside MONK on the deck or the grass above the beach while she paints, in the open air rather than in a room.
programs.our_note: This is a home studio address in a residential close, not a gallery with a front desk, so phone first and say how many children are coming. It is outdoors on a deck or grass, which means no wet weather plan is published and nothing is said about washrooms. If what you want is a painting session, that is arranged through the same contact as MONK Art Gallery & Studio and is recorded there.
programs.practical_summary: Everything here happens outside on a deck or on grass by the beach, so weather and footwear matter. Washrooms, lunch space, parking and a rain plan are all unpublished, so ask before you commit a group.
programs.evidence: Sunday: Monk can be visited on Rathtrevor Beach in Parksville where she paints.

images.alt: Two children paint a wide canvas on a wooden easel set up on grass above a sandy beach, with an adult standing beside them and paint palettes on the ground.

gaps: MONK Art Gallery & Studio is the same business at a second Parksville address, on Morison Avenue in the centre of town. It is recorded separately under that name, and the Paint with MONK offering is recorded there rather than here so that a director is not shown the same thing twice.

The site does not say which of the two addresses a booked painting session actually runs at. The one photograph of people painting was taken on grass above the beach, which points here, but nothing on the site states it. Worth asking.
No price, no length, no age range, no youngest age and no group size are published for anything at this address.
The site never mentions schools or daycares, so whether a class or a daycare group can come here is unknown.

Nothing is published about washrooms, an indoor lunch space, a wet weather plan, step free access or where a bus would park. The address is a unit in a residential close, so parking a bus is worth asking about early.
No email address is published. Contact is by phone or by the form on the contact page.

The point on the map here comes from Tanglewood Place itself rather than from the unit door, because no coordinates are published and the house number could not be matched. Expect to be within a block rather than at the right driveway.
The Sunday line about visiting MONK on Rathtrevor Beach sits inside the gallery opening times in the footer, so it is not clear whether it means this address or the beach itself.
